text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I was just one step away...! I guess 
you really won't let me win easily...!
choice_data_list: The GⅠ wall really is high.
The GⅠ wall really is high.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, but I'm not gonna whine about it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely claim the next Tiara. 
Even if you begged me, I would never give 
up and kneel here."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the way I am right now won't cut 
it. ...She's gotten stronger, too."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not like I'm scared or anything. 
I was just stating a fact."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, taking first place is out 
of reach. I need to get much, much 
stronger...!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's a waste of time to dwell on regrets. 
The next Tiara... the Oaks is right around 
the corner, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone steal the throne of 
Queen of the Oaks. ...The one who takes 
first place will be me!
